name: zavri
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design one exceptionally disciplined identity proof sheet for a real learning-center operations platform coordinating people, physical materials, observations, progress and a whole center's day. This is an original professional graphic identity project, with the restraint and precise optical spacing of an experienced identity designer. Landscape 3:2 sheet, pure white #ffffff, near-black navy #202b48 and flat blue #5b93ce only. Absolutely no gradients, fake lighting, shadows, textures, lens effects, bevels, glossy rendering, stock mockups or 3D. No books, pages, graduation caps, gears, sparkles, brains, circuit nodes, globes, infinity signs, generic swooshes or four-point stars. Avoid a rounded-square app badge around the main symbol. Make a distinctive ownable flat silhouette from at most three deliberate geometric elements, with ample internal gaps and no fine detail. Typography is a carefully spaced robust contemporary grotesk with subtle purposeful customization, confident medium-bold weight, no futuristic sci-fi font. Spacious editorial arrangement: dominant horizontal symbol + wordmark lockup across the upper-middle half; a small pure-black standalone mark at bottom left; a reversed white mark on a small solid navy rectangular swatch at bottom center; a restrained actual-size corner-header example at bottom right on a white surface, with the same mark at 39px next to its wordmark. All repeated symbols must be exactly consistent. Main mark blue, wordmark navy. Keep marks usable at 24px. Only text is the brand wordmark repeated for the main lockup and small header, and a very small label 'Identity study' in the upper left. No taglines, no captions about meaning, no measurement arrows, no decoration, no trademark signs. Do not borrow or imitate any existing company's identity. Brand wordmark exactly 'zavri', lowercase, spelled z-a-v-r-i. Original symbol concept: a compact angular Z that reads as a connected mechanical joint, with two broad opposing bent strokes and a deliberate diagonal channel of white negative space separating them. Use a controlled 45-degree diagonal and horizontal terminals, slight optical rounding only at two outer corners. Give it a fresh asymmetric proportion rather than the ubiquitous lightning bolt. It should feel quick, assured, precise and human. The Z must have a convincing strong black silhouette without visual tangles. The wordmark's z and v should subtly echo the mark's angle, with a conventional clearly legible a and r. The little i dot is circular, not a star. This is the lead identity in a shortlist, so prioritize disciplined simplicity over novelty tricks.
